GLS.feature.stream.title: Stream Client
GLS.feature.stream.hint: A dedicated login for OBS or browser capture: hides Foundry's UI, frames the canvas camera, and shows chat and presentation overlays. A control panel drives the live shot.
User id of the dedicated stream client. The Director UI provides a user picker.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.autoStartStre: Stream user ids that should enter stream mode automatically without prompting.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.trustedDirect: User ids allowed to operate stream controls in addition to GMs.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.uiRules.name: Stream UI Rules
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.uiRules.hint: Allow/block rules for detected floating UI and expert CSS selectors.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.keybindings.emergencyR: Temporarily restore or hide Foundry UI while stream mode remains active.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.startPrompt.title: Start Stream Mode?
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.startPrompt.body: This user is configured as the stream client. Start stream mode for this session?
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.startPrompt.alwaysHint: Always enter stream mode on this user at startup. A Stream Director can revoke this later.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.notifications.notDirec: You are not allowed to operate stream controls.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.controlRoom.name: Stream Control Room
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.controlRoom.label: Open Control Room
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.controlRoom.hint: Start and stop the stream, frame the camera, and set the chat, dialog and UI rules for the capture client.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.notifications.readOnly: Your changes cannot be saved: this world does not allow a non-GM director to send them. Ask a GM to make the change, or to run the stream themselves.
Your changes cannot be saved while no GM is connected: a director's edits are applied by a GM's client. This panel starts saving again as soon as one signs in.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.chatFilter.hi: Which content types reach the stream chat overlay, set separately for players and the GM.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.chatFilter.name: Stream Chat Filter
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.chatFilter.label: Open Chat Filter
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.chatFilter.hint: Choose exactly what the stream overlay shows — checks, damage, spells, plain rolls, typed chat, status changes — separately for what players post and what the GM posts.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.title: Stream Chat Filter
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.intro: Tick what the stream overlay may show. Each content type is switched separately for messages a player posted and messages the GM posted. Changes apply to the next card; cards already on screen stay until they expire.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.privacy: Whispers, GM blind rolls and other players’ private messages never reach the stream, whatever is ticked here.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.notApplicab: Does not apply to this column
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.presets.noC: Turn off in-character speech, emotes and out-of-character chat for everyone. Rolls and statuses are untouched.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.presets.rol: Show checks, damage, spells, actions and dice rolls; hide typed chat, status cards and everything else.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.presets.def: Put every switch back to its default.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.group.check: PF2e rolls against a DC or defence.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.group.actio: What a check leads to, and the cards for using an ability.
Rolls no system claimed as a check.
Lines a person typed into the chat box.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.group.statu: Conditions and effects arriving, changing or ending. Here the columns are whose creature it is: a player character, or one the GM runs (which also has to be visible on the scene).
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.group.other: Only used where chat cards are cloned as-is (non-PF2e worlds, or Roll Cards switched off).
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.skill.h: Athletics, Stealth, Recall Knowledge and every other skill.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.percept: Seek, Sense Motive and other Perception rolls.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.initiat: Initiative rolls when an encounter starts.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.flat.hi: Concealment, persistent damage recovery, stupefied and other flat checks.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.counter: Dispel Magic and other counteract attempts.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.check.h: Any PF2e check of no more specific kind.
Damage rolls, merged under the attack or spell that caused them when that card is shown.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.spell.h: The card a spell posts when it is cast.
Cards for using an action or feat with no roll of its own.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.roll.hi: /r 2d6+3, macro rolls, and any roll that is not a check or damage.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.ooc.hin: Table talk, and anything typed with no character speaking.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.conditi: Frightened, prone, dying, persistent damage and the rest of the printed list.
Spell effects, stances and feat effects. There are a great many of these.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.other.h: Item cards, system summaries and messages from other modules.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detailsHint: What a shown roll card may say. A GM roll never shows its DC or a player name, so those have no GM switch.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detail.degr: Critical success, success, failure or critical failure.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detail.dc.h: The DC a player rolled against.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detail.targ: Who the roll was against. A name players cannot see is hidden either way.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detail.play: The name of the person who rolled, under the character.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.nonPf2e: Roll card details (degree, DC, target, player name) apply to PF2e roll cards only. In this world chat cards are cloned as-is.
